paragraphs: New in Blue sells technology platforms for law enforcement. The company is led by a retired chief of police and municipal executive.

Tickets On The Go is an eCitation smartphone app that fills in a citation form and lets officers share tickets with a defendant by print, email or text message. Review the Blue is a system for bridging the gap between public sentiment and Law Enforcement Officers. Blue Trace is a cloud-based SAAS process for officer safety, offered to agencies of all sizes with no start-up costs.

Goldline RMS is a record management system with integration to Goldline CAD and Tickets On The Go. Goldline CAD is listed with tight integration to Goldline RMS and Silent Dispatch. seQRsmart is a security inspection app for managing security checkpoints. The pages state that the solutions are compliant with state and federal reporting mandates and provide public safety agencies real-time information.

quote.text: Technology Built by Cops for Cops
